title: Pokkiri
desc: Thamizh, an undercover officer posing as a hitman, falls for Shruthi, who disapproves of his violent lifestyle. Their growing bond faces risks from his hidden mission.

title: Vedhalam
desc: Ganesh, a taxi driver, leads a peaceful life. One day, upon helping the police seize three criminals, he incurs the wrath of a criminal network, following which his real identity is revealed.

title: Vivegam
desc: Ajay Kumar, a former counter-terrorism agent, is called for a special mission. However, he is betrayed by his friends and is accused of extremely treasonous acts.

title: Ghost
desc: A gangster and his team hijack a prison in the city on a quest for justice. Eventually, they threaten to release all the criminals.

title: Hidimbha
desc: In Hyderabad, a series of murders targets young girls. Later, officers Aadhya and Abhay investigate as more victims disappear, soon discovering a common link among them.
